title: Resolves an address into its ENS reverse record on a given chain, with batch sup
description: Resolves an address into its ENS reverse record on a given chain, with batch support up to 50 addresses and per-address chain scoping via interop addresses.

_signals.x_guidance: JustaName ENS resolution: GET /ens/v2/resolve?ens=<name> for forward, GET /ens/v2/reverse?address=<addr> for reverse. Both are pay-per-call (0.001 USDC on Base via x402 v2 or MPP-charge draft-01). Send X-Rpc-Url with your own HTTPS Ethereum RPC URL to skip payment (caller pays upstream RPC compute). Batch up to 50 names/addresses per call by repeating the query parameter.
